explanation: OEIS A011545 (R. Holmes' comment and editorial note): the collision-count interpretation is equivalent to 'the interval (mπ, π/arctan(1/m)) does not contain an integer for all m = 10^n', which is 'not known to be true for sure'. The formal statement is exactly that no integer k satisfies 10^n π < k < π/arctan(10^{−n}), for every n. Faithful.
